column5: F1 (BLOCKER) the W12 fixture wrote one 6 MB string with a declared array length of 6 000 000, so the probe's `base + 8n > size` guard graded it invalid and the cell could never reach MODEL_OK; repaired in amendments 2 then 3 (interleaved 9-byte elements, 54 000 049 B, measured MODEL_OK). F2 the per-header cost is `5 + nd`, not a constant 6. F3 four preamble steps put the nd=1 ceiling at 833,332. F5 the counter docstring still said MAX_STEPS 4 000 000. F6 the base control ran with --skip-load. F7 W03's truncation belongs to round 94's constant wrapper.

Same W12 BLOCKER found independently, with the root cause traced through skip_strings; the instrument's own guards held (--skip-load cannot pass, halved MAX_STEPS reddens cells, KILL 1200 > 1020 s derived, truncated pass = mismatch). Also found the margin message printed 1.2 while enforcing 75 s, and flagged the host-speed dependence of --slow-files 40.

Four mutants survive all 12 cells: MAX_STEPS removed, per-header charging removed, MAX_META lowered to 100 MiB, ctime dropped from the memo key. Cause: every fixture's complete parse is also `-`. Amendment 6 adds W13-budget-kill (capped `-`, uncapped `invalid`; measured MODEL_OK 0.72 s vs MODEL_UNLOADED 0.87 s), so the cap is now graded; the other three stay disclosed for round 97.

Caught the base control being run at the tip (summary probe_sha256 = the tip's probe), the shared-scratch collision that destroyed both receipts, and a NEW arithmetic defect: the nd=3 ceiling is 624 999, not 625 000, and the depth counter carried the wrong value as a required needle. Amendments 3, 4 and the re-run base control answer all three.

Binary-searched the whole boundary: `5 + nd` per header, 4 preamble steps, per-rank ceilings (999 999 / 833 332 / 714 285 / 624 999 / 555 555), and re-confirmed W12 and W11 end to end through the real probe; its Part B re-measures the repairs and the boundary numbers the SKILL table now states.
Re-derived the per-header cost from the need() call sites and confirmed the S618 quote and digest; the arithmetic gaps it found (nd dependence, preamble) are answered by amendments 2 and 4.

Base red (`checks=5 mismatches=2` at the time of its run) and tip green; the instrument discriminates, K3 not triggered.
